note: Both sets capture the core elevations (finished floor 2'-9 1/2" and grade 0'-0") and room containment, and both repeat the same misread value 2'-3 1/2" for the Living Room finished floor, which is not on the page. Set A adds several misbound or trivial claims: grid marker K treated as the Centre Module's location, sheet number A302 as a room 'location', 'WEST MODULE | location | West' as tautology, and detail bubble A1 treated as a drawing number for the scale. Set B instead correctly binds the 3/8"=1'-0" scales to the Living Room Section (A1) and Centre Module section (C1), and adds supported sheet metadata (A-302, BUILDING SECTIONS, lot number 116). Set B's only other weakness is the 'West Module adjacent to Centre Module' claim, whose quote does not itself support adjacency.
